caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: The Apple iOS CoreCrypto Module is a software cryptographic module running on a multi-chip standalone mobile device and provides services intended to protect data in transit and at rest.
